senses.en: determination to be successful, rich, powerful, etc.
examples: She was intelligent but suffered from a lack of [[ambition]].

senses.en: a strong desire to achieve sth.
examples: Earlier this year, he achieved his [[ambition]] of competing in the Olympic Games.

senses.zh: 有抱负的；有雄心的；野心勃勃的
senses.en: determined to be successful, rich, powerful, etc.
examples: She's extremely [[ambitious]] and intends to be running her own company by the time she's 30.

senses.zh: 将来会有一天；有朝一日
senses.en: (also 'some day') at an unknown time in the future, esp. a long time in the future
examples: He hopes, [[someday]], to have his own business.

senses.zh: 就事论事地；不带感情地；实事求是地
senses.en: in a way that shows no emotion when you are talking about sth. exciting, frightening, etc.
examples: To my surprise, he spoke about his divorce [[matter-of-factly]].

senses.en: the scientific study of living things
examples: Students might pursue a degree in [[biology]] as a path to medical school or a variety of professions.

senses.en: find a satisfactory way of dealing with a problem or difficulty
examples: There weren't enough beds, but the matter was [[resolved]] by George sleeping on the sofa.

senses.en: books and stories about imaginary people and events
examples: The book is a work of [[fiction]] and not intended as a historical account.

senses.en: (AmE) a student in the first year of high school or university
examples: It is necessary for [[freshmen]] to get to know their new studying environment in university as soon as possible.

senses.en: behave as if sth. is true when in fact you know it is not, in order to deceive people or for fun
examples: She [[pretended]] that she was not at home when we rang the bell.

senses.zh: 非常需要···的；极其需要···的
senses.en: (~ for sth.; ~ to do sth.) needing or wanting sth. very much
examples: The healthcare industry is [[desperate]] for solutions to its business models.

senses.zh: （为了改变糟糕境遇而）不惜冒险的，拼命的，绝望的
senses.en: willing to do anything to change a very bad situation, and not caring about danger
examples: I had no money left and was [[desperate]].

senses.en: (infml.) a friend
examples: Bob and I have been great [[buddies]] for years.

senses.en: amusing and interesting
examples: His books aren't particularly well-written, but they're always [[entertaining]].

senses.en: showing or saying that you are sorry that sth. has happened, esp. because you feel guilty or embarrassed about it
examples: She was [[apologetic]] about my injury.

senses.zh: （通过长时间努力而）得到，获得，赢得
senses.en: succeed in achieving sth. after trying for a long time
examples: More and more women are [[attaining]] positions of power.

senses.zh: 可以达到的；可以获得的
senses.en: possible to achieve, reach, or get
examples: We must make sure that we do not set ourselves goals that are not [[attainable]].

senses.en: the quality of trying to do sth. even when it is difficult
examples: He shows great [[determination]] to learn English.

senses.zh: 现实的；实际的；实事求是的
senses.en: accepting things as they are in fact and not making decisions based on unlikely hopes for the future
examples: Let's be [[realistic]] about this 一 I just can't afford to pay that much money.

senses.en: a thick tropical forest with many large plants growing very close together
examples: We had to cut our way through dense [[jungle]].

senses.zh: 命运决定的；命中注定的
senses.en: certain to happen or to do sth. because a mysterious force is controlling events
examples: She says she was [[fated]] to become a writer.

senses.zh: 喜欢冒险的；有冒险精神的
senses.en: eager to go to new places and do exciting or dangerous things
examples: I took an [[adventurous]] ski trip in Austria last year.

senses.en: not afraid of taking risks or trying new things
examples: Warren is a very [[adventurous]] cook, always trying to make new dishes.

senses.zh: 异国风情的；外国情调的
senses.en: sth. that is exotic seems unusual and interesting because it is related to a foreign country
examples: She likes traveling to all kinds of [[exotic]] locations.

senses.en: (~ of) a group of similar things
examples: We've had a [[string]] of complaints about the program.
Her key hung on a [[string]] around her neck.

senses.en: (strung, strung) put things together onto a thread, chain, etc.
examples: She had [[strung]] the shells on a silver chain.

senses.en: a state of disagreement or argument between people, groups, countries, etc.
examples: She found herself in [[conflict]] with her parents over her future career.

senses.zh: 全心全意地；全力以赴地
senses.en: in a way that involves all your feelings, interest, etc.
examples: I agree [[whole-heartedly]] with the mayor on this issue.

senses.zh: 一心一意地；专心致志地
senses.en: if one person does sth. single-mindedly, they have one clear aim and work very hard to achieve it
examples: His ability to concentrate [[single-mindedly]] on the most important thing leads to his success.

senses.zh: 贪婪的；贪心的； 贪吃的；贪喝的
senses.en: always wanting more food, money, power, possessions, etc. than you need
examples: He looked at the gold with [[greedy]] eyes.

senses.zh: 混乱的； 毫无秩序的
senses.en: a chaotic situation is one in which everything is happening in a confused way
examples: The traffic in the city is [[chaotic]] in the rush hour.

senses.en: if sb. /sth. is overdue, they should have arrived before now
examples: If you're [[overdue]] for a vacation, you can prepare for an adventure instead of cancelling it.

senses.zh: 过期未完成的；过期未付的；过期未还的
senses.en: not done, paid, returned, etc. by the time expected
examples: These books are [[overdue]] and you should pay a fine.

senses.zh: （尤指小孩或年轻人举止）成熟的，理智的，明白事理的
senses.en: sb., esp. a child or young person, who is mature behaves in a sensible and reasonable way, as you would expect an adult to behave
examples: We're [[mature]] enough to disagree on this issue but still respect each other.

senses.en: give sb. a particular job or make them responsible for a particular person or thing
examples: I've been [[assigned]] the task of looking after the new students.

senses.en: (BrE paediatrician) a doctor who deals with children and their illnesses
examples: He dreams of becoming a doctor, specifically a [[pediatrician]].

senses.en: a popular product, esp. a book, that many people buy
examples: His new book went straight to No. 1 on the [[best-seller]] list.

senses.en: (often used in negative sentences or questions) any longer
examples: You're describing a world that just doesn't exist [[anymore]].

senses.en: (strove, striven) (~ to do sth.; ~ for / after sth.) make a great effort to achieve sth.
examples: We encourage all members to [[strive]] for the highest standards.

senses.en: (only before noun) extremely popular
examples: It's almost every author's dream to become a [[best-selling]] author.

senses.zh: 记者招待会；新闻发布会
senses.en: a meeting held by a person or group at which they answer questions from people who write or present news reports
examples: The football coach held a [[press conference]] to announce his retirement.

senses.en: attractive or interesting
examples: The city offers an [[appealing]] combination of sporting and cultural events.

senses.en: a feeling of sadness that makes you think there is no hope for the future
examples: She suffered from severe [[depression]] after losing her job.

senses.en: when sb. feels alone and unable to meet or speak to other people
examples: After all the visitors had left, she experienced a feeling of complete [[isolation]].

senses.en: when one group, person, or thing is separate from others
examples: Because of its geographical [[isolation]], the area developed its own unique culture.

senses.en: sb. who is paid to work for sb. else
examples: Alibaba Group has more than 100,000 global [[employees]].

senses.en: sb. who studies and develops ideas about the nature and meaning of existence, truth, good and evil, etc.
examples: Socrates and Plato are two famous Greek [[philosophers]] whose ideas are still influential today.

senses.zh: （使）（故事、计划等）展开；逐渐呈现；展示
senses.en: if a story, plan, etc. unfolds, it becomes clearer as you hear or learn more about it
examples: The scandal is still [[unfolding]], but there may be a solution soon.

senses.en: sb.'s general attitude, and the way in which they think about things and make decisions
examples: It's quite difficult to change the [[mindset]] of the public and the press.

senses.en: become smaller in size, importance, or value, or make sth. do this
examples: The new project will [[lessen]] the effects of car pollution.

senses.en: (only before noun) relating to your feelings or how you control them
examples: Mothers are often the ones who provide [[emotional]] support for the family.

senses.en: (fml.) notice, see, or recognize sth.
examples: That morning, he [[perceived]] a change in his wife's mood.

senses.en: (written) understand or think of sb. / sth. in a particular way
examples: Even as a young woman she had been [[perceived]] as a future chief executive.

senses.en: extremely brave or determined, and admired by many people
examples: These doctors performed [[heroic]] work in difficult conditions.

senses.zh: （行为、态度、标准等）一贯的，一致的
senses.en: always behaving in the same way or having the same attitudes, standards, etc.
examples: He has been the team's most [[consistent]] player.

senses.en: able to continue for a long time
examples: That sort of extreme diet is not [[sustainable]] over a long period.

senses.en: when you are healthy and strong enough to do hard work or play sports
examples: They're doing some regular exercise to improve their [[fitness]].

senses.en: the ability to use your imagination to produce new ideas, make things, etc.
examples: We should have an education system that lets children use their [[creativity]].

senses.en: a long race of about 42 kilometers or 26 miles
examples: She ran her first [[marathon]] in just under three hours.

senses.en: used to emphasize that sth., esp. a large number, is actually true
examples: The Olympic Games were watched by [[literally]] billions of people around the world.

senses.zh: 按照原意；根据字面意思
senses.en: according to the most basic or original meaning of a word or expression
examples: I said I felt like quitting, but I didn't mean it [[literally]].

senses.zh: 把···做得过分；把···使用过头
senses.en: try to do or use too much of sth., causing problems, illness, or damage
examples: Be careful not to [[overextend]] yourself. You've been very ill.

senses.zh: 使痴迷；使迷恋；使心神不宁（含贬义）
senses.en: (be obsessed with / by) if sb. / sth. obsesses you, you think or worry about them all the time and you cannot think about anything else — used to show disapproval
examples: A lot of young girls are [[obsessed]] by their weight.

senses.zh: 最大量的；最大限度的；最大值的
senses.en: (only before noun) the maximum amount, quantity, speed, etc. is the largest that is possible or is allowed
examples: To get the [[maximum]] benefit, do the exercises slowly.

senses.en: a period of physical exercise, esp. as training for a sport
examples: She does a 20-minute [[workout]] every morning.

senses.en: used to contrast sb. / sth. with another person or thing
examples: [[Unlike]] most people in the office, I don't come to work by car.

senses.en: a situation that seems strange because it involves two ideas or qualities that are very different
examples: It is a [[paradox]] that in such a rich country there can be so much poverty.

senses.en: a statement that seems impossible because it contains two opposing ideas that are both true
examples: The [[paradox]] is that fishermen would catch more fish if they fished less.

senses.en: (~ well / badly, etc.) work or do sth. well, badly, etc.
examples: The company has been [[performing]] poorly over the past year.

senses.en: do sth. to entertain people, for example by acting a play or playing a piece of music
examples: I'd like to hear the music [[performed]] live.

senses.en: use a lot of time and effort trying to get sth. such as work or money
examples: Top graduates from the university are [[chased]] by major companies.

senses.en: quickly follow sb. / sth. in order to catch them
examples: The dogs saw him running and [[chased]] him.

senses.en: sb. who is grounded understands their own character and knows what is really important
examples: Mary says that she knows what she really wants because her family always keeps her [[grounded]].

senses.zh: 理性的；有理智的；克制的
senses.en: 2）reasonable and in control of your emotions, even when this is difficult
examples: Charles can always keep himself [[grounded]], even when he runs into difficulty.

senses.zh: 多产的；丰饶的；富有成效的
senses.en: producing or achieving a lot
examples: We had a very [[productive]] meeting 一 I felt we sorted out a lot of problems.

senses.zh: （某团体的）精神特质，道德意识
senses.en: the set of ideas and moral attitudes that are typical of a particular group
examples: It is a community in which people lived according to an [[ethos]] of sharing and caring.

senses.zh: 某人只要提出要求（就可以得到）
senses.en: (infml.) if sth. is yours for the asking, you can have it if you want it
examples: A good deal of extra support [[is hers for the asking]].

senses.en: have great success
examples: I wasn't expecting it to work, but I [[hit it big]] when I tried the new approach.

senses.en: (spoken) used when giving your personal opinion or admitting sth.
examples: [[To tell the truth]], I don't really like her.

senses.en: not take sb. / sth. with you when you leave a place
examples: He departed for the United States, [[leaving]] the children [[behind]] with his mother.

senses.en: relax and make no effort to get involved in sth. or influence what happens
examples: Don't just [[sit back]] and wait for new business to come to you.

senses.zh: 由于这样或那样的原因
senses.en: used for saying that there is more than one reason for sth.
examples: His travel articles are always, [[for one reason or another]], fascinating.

senses.zh: 抓住（机会）；立即接受（邀请等）
senses.en: (infml.) take an opportunity, accept an invitation, etc. immediately
examples: This is our chance to [[grab at]] this new market.

senses.zh: 与某事妥协，对某事让步；接受（令人不快或悲伤的现实）
senses.en: accept an unpleasant or sad situation and no longer feel upset or angry about it
examples: It's hard for the couple to [[come to terms with]] the fact that they will never have children.

senses.zh: 阻碍某人 / 某事发展
senses.en: prevent sb. / sth. from making progress
examples: Do you think that mixed-ability teaching [[holds]] the brighter children [[back]]?

senses.en: (infml.) if a name or phrase rolls or trips off your tongue, it is easy or pleasant to say
examples: Their names [[roll off the tongue]] very easily.

senses.en: be in a state of physical or mental exhaustion caused by overwork or stress
examples: He [[was burned out]] by the time he was 21 and retired from the sport.

senses.en: the present time
examples: To be able to live fully in [[the here and now]], one must first learn how to honor the past.

senses.en: fail to win or achieve sth.
examples: We're so close to getting the job done, but we keep [[coming up short]].

senses.en: increase by small amounts until there is a large total
examples: When you're feeding a family of six the bills soon [[add up]].

senses.en: combine things in order to make sth. that is complete, good, useful, etc.
examples: They [[string together]] image after image until the documentary is completed.

senses.en: (fml.) before
examples: All the arrangements should be completed [[prior to]] your departure.

senses.en: if you are at peace, you do not feel angry, unhappy, etc.
examples: For the first time in months, she felt calm and [[at peace]] with the world.

senses.en: used to say that sth. is completely different from what has just been said
examples: I didn't feel sleepy at all 一 [[just the opposite]], in fact.

senses.zh: 违背某事；与某事背道而驰
senses.en: be the opposite of
examples: The governor's newest policy seems to be [[running counter to]] everything he promised during his election campaign.

senses.zh: （美国政府的）国务卿（主要负责外交事务）
简·古多尔（英国生物学家、动物行为学家、人类学家）
J.J. 瓦特（美国橄榄球运动员）
埃利乌德 ; 基普乔盖（肯尼亚马拉松运动员）
